detailed_description:
The video is shot from a first-person perspective (POV) with a cinematic, continuous storytelling style set inside <Subject 6>, the illuminated traditional Chinese study with soft daylight filtering through the bamboo trees outside.

[Shot 1] The camera is fixed at eye level facing the center of <Subject 6> near the wooden tea table. <Subject 1> (S1), the red-gold-haired young man with long red tassel earrings and royal blue draped outfit, steps forward from beside the bamboo screen toward the viewer, lowering his crossed arms as he approaches. He stops close to the lens, tilts his head slightly, looks directly at the camera with sharp amber eyes, and speaks using the clear voice timbre and cadence referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 终于等到你了，欢迎来到我们的茶室。</d> He smiles slightly, gestures with a flick of his golden bracer-adorned wrist, and steps gracefully to the left side of the frame.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, <Subject 2> (S2), the red-haired woman in the cream knit shirt, walks forward from behind the calligraphy desk into the center foreground. Holding a porcelain teacup with both hands, she looks brightly into the camera with a warm expression and speaks in the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 你好呀，快坐下尝尝刚泡好的新茶吧。</d> She nods warmly, takes a small sip, and steps to the right side of the frame.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, <Subject 3> (S3), the woman with the dark bun and white off-the-shoulder sweater, walks confidently forward toward the camera from the sunlit window background. She stops in front of the viewer, leans slightly forward with a playful smile, waving her hand close to the lens, and speaks in the same voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 嗨！今天天气真好，很高兴见到你哦！</d> She turns slightly and gestures toward the rest of the room before moving aside.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, <Subject 4> (S4), the young woman with cat ears and blue hair highlights in the white t-shirt, playfully hops forward into the close-up shot facing the viewer. She touches one of her cat ears, winks at the camera, and speaks in the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 喵~ 终于轮到我打招呼啦，今天也要开心呀！</d> She makes a small paw-gesturing wave with her hand and steps back.

[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, <Subject 5> (S5), the woman with mauve-pink hair and glasses in the grey suit, adjusts her glasses with one hand while holding a blue notebook, stepping calmly into the center foreground. Looking elegantly into the camera with a gentle smile, she speaks in the refined voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 你好，大家都等候多时了，请随我们来吧。</d> She gracefully bows her head slightly, extends her arm toward the tea table, and all five characters briefly align in the background looking toward the camera as the frame freezes at 00:15.000.

overall_soundscape:
Gentle breeze through bamboo leaves, peaceful indoor room tone with soft tea-pouring sounds continuing faintly in the background.

non_diegetic_music:
A soft, elegant traditional Chinese guqin and bamboo flute melody playing softly in the background.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the cyan and white robotic cat mecha from <Picture 1>, featuring large glowing blue optical eyes, a cat-eared mechanical helmet, mint-cyan armor with flower patterns, mechanical joint servos, and tattered beige cape elements.
<Subject 2> is the elegant female dancer Boss from <Picture 3>, featuring sheer sparkling silver-gray hanfu robes, intricate gold hair accessories, long dark hair, and traditional headwear with hanging ornaments.
<Environment 1> is the snowy mountain temple setting from <Picture 2>, featuring snow-covered ground, ancient temple structures, icy cliffs, and falling snow.
<Picture 1> is the character design reference sheet for <Subject 1>.
<Picture 2> is the environment design reference sheet for <Environment 1>.
<Picture 3> is the character design reference sheet for <Subject 2>.

summary:
[reference generation] A 10-second photorealistic first-person comedic RPG gameplay sequence in <Environment 1>, where <Subject 1> holds the bare foot of defeated Boss <Subject 2> and meticulously trims her big toenail with a knife in macro close-up, leaving her completely bewildered.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the mint-cyan mechanical paws/gauntlets, cyan armor plates with flower details, and dark joint mechanics from <Picture 1> are fully preserved.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the silver-gray hanfu robes, gold headpiece ornaments, long dark hair, and facial features from <Picture 3> are fully preserved.
<Environment 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the snowy terrain, ancient temple, and cold mountain backdrop from <Picture 2> are fully preserved.

detailed_description:
The target video features a photorealistic 3D first-person perspective comedic gameplay cutscene rendered in Unreal Engine with macro depth of field and high-contrast lighting.
[Shot 1] The video opens in a first-person POV in <Environment 1>. Mechanical paws of <Subject 1> hold a sharp tactical knife in the right hand and gently clasp <Subject 2>'s foot in the left. <Subject 2> lies in the snow behind her foot with closed eyes, anticipating an attack.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera zooms into an extreme macro close-up of <Subject 2>'s big toe held firmly by <Subject 1>'s mechanical paw. The tactical blade carefully scrapes the toenail edge, shaving off tiny white particles with precise micro-movements.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the camera tilts up slightly toward <Subject 2>'s face in the background. <Subject 2> opens her dark eyes, frozen in extreme confusion as she realizes her toenails are being groomed under her silver headpiece.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the camera shifts back down to the newly manicured toe. The knife finishes the final scrape, blowing away dust to reveal a sparkling, perfectly shaped toenail gleaming in the light until 00:10.016.

overall_soundscape:
Gentle female breathing, metallic blade scraping against toenail, subtle snow crunching, soft wind, and a comedic gleam chime.

non_diegetic_music:
Tense battle music abruptly fading into a lighthearted, quirky comedic acoustic tune during the grooming process.
